protocol.acceptance: Existing native convergence/bounds/joint time-error gates only. Report same-phase cycle differences and compare them with observed time/mesh sensitivity; no new universal physical tolerance.
protocol.repair: On-demand pressure residual cap derived from unchanged scalar carrier budget; same physical controls.

postprocessing: All quantities read from native accepted histories and fields. Heat is K*m^2, flux K*m^2/s. Cycle moments use trapezoidal history integration; wall integrals use native accepted-step right-end flux*dt. Fundamental lag is relative to the positive-sine first harmonic of the square input. No PDE reconstruction or physical accuracy gate is added.

carrierRepair.pressureResidualCap: 0.5 * unchanged scalar carrierAbsoluteTolerance / sqrt(max(1,N-1)); used only after a typed continuity mismatch; original face check remains decisive

limitations: Current native 2D incompressible laminar, constant-property passive temperature only; no temperature feedback into flow.
Actual adaptive time grids differ, so same-control mesh differences do not prove time-independent spatial order or physical qualification.
Last-cycle field repeat difference is reported, not compared to an invented universal periodicity tolerance.
Fundamental amplitude mesh differences are nonmonotone and smaller than the tested time-step difference on the fine pair.
The GUI cavity uses its upwind scalar convection and its saved thermal boundaries; it is an operation case separate from the limited-linear periodic study.
Future sustained unsteady-flow/temperature evidence and final delivery closeout remain; old 16212-cell bounded Pe=30 run is still separate and not counted complete.
Windows/Linux GUI, signed release and a new cancellation/kill workflow were not tested in this increment.
